observations.command:
set -eu
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
cat /proc/uptime
set +e
/usr/bin/input_keyevent Up down
key_down_status=$?
sleep 0.15
/usr/bin/input_keyevent Up up
key_up_status=$?
echo KEY_DOWN_EXIT=$key_down_status KEY_UP_EXIT=$key_up_status
sleep 0.2
{ /usr/bin/vlogutil -v kerneltime -t 3 2>&1; source_exit=$?; echo VLOG_SOURCE_EXIT=$source_exit; } | grep -Ei 'eden_onfocus|OnFocused|OnUnfocused|KEY_RELEASE.*(Up|Right)|VLOG_SOURCE_EXIT' | tail -c 24000
vconftool get memory/eden/current_tab
cat /proc/uptime
